newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Canberra names new Northern Territory chief.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Canberra names new Northern Territory chief.

text.p: The Australian government on Thursday named a senior public servant as the next Administrator of the Northern Territory.

Neil Conn, 60, will take up his three-year post in February, replacing Austin Asche, who was appointed in 1993 and whose term expires at the end of 1996, Territories Minister Warwick Smith said in a statement.

Conn is under treasurer of the territory's Treasury and has been deputy treasurer of New South Wales state Treasury, principal administrator of the OECD growth studies division and an economic lecturer at Sydney University.
The administrator is the territory equivalent of a state governor.
